answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the oasis checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The knoll graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the crystal audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 6 times its size, so a group of 20 keys loses far more than 20 single identities would. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
